text:
ben: deploybot auto-paused the release window — CI failing on publish step, got partial upload + verify fail. Holding promo.
tara: seen a handful of `checksum mismatch` errors in the logs, looks like multipart finalize sometimes returns 502 and registry marks manifest unfinalized.
infra: confirmed: registry returned 502 during finalization for artifact wheel-2026-03-25-b2. We have corrupted manifest and a stale index entry.
deploy-bot: automated: promotion halted at step=artifact-publish; last-known-good=docker.redwood/inference:2026-03-24-a5f7c2. Command to continue: `deploybot promote --to-image a5f7c2 --force --reason "manual-pin-after-publish-fail"`
qa-lead: PMs want the patch today. Two options: 1) pin to last-known-good and proceed with extra smoke, 2) rebuild & republish (risking same transient error, ~25m).
ben: recommend pin + immediate postmortem. We should also add a CI preflight that verifies manifest finalize before promoting.
tara: agreed. infra, can you add short-term retry-with-jitter on finalize and an alert on incomplete manifests?
infra: on it — will increase finalize retries (5 -> 10) with exponential backoff and jitter, and create INF-1133 to track root cause. Rolling change to staging now.
deploy-bot: note: pin recommended. Use `deploybot promote --to-image a5f7c2 --reason "pin-due-to-publish-failure"`
ben: tara, can you run the promote and kick off smoke? I'll update the release notes and request PM approval for prod.
tara: running `deploybot promote --to-image a5f7c2 --reason "pin-for-release-window"` now.
deploy-bot: Promotion started. canary rollout to staging at 10%. Health checks enabled.
qa-lead: smoke harness running subset of e2e. If green in 10m, request manual approval for prod cut.
infra: staging finalize retry change deployed; monitoring shows fewer 5xxs. Ticket INF-1133 created.
deploy-bot: Promotion succeeded in staging. Prod promotion remains manual.
ben: thanks all. Decision: manual pin to last-known-good, postpone automated prod cut until postmortem complete. Closing thread.
